newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four bombs explode in Corsican town.
newsitem.headline: Four bombs explode in Corsican town.

text.p: Four bombs exploded in the Corsican town of Ajaccio early on Sunday, causing some damage but no injuries, police said.
The small bombs targeted the Credit Agricole and Societe Generale banks, an office of the forestry board and a post office.

No one immediately claimed responsibility for the attacks which bore the hallmarks of Corsican separatists who are waging a bombing campaign to demand more autonomy from France for the Mediterranean island.
